days.title: The Dried Waterfall and Surroundings
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Döda fallet
stops.detail: Döda fallet, The Dead Fall, is the current name for the site where the Swedish waterfall Gedungsen (also: Storforsen) was formerly located.

stops.name: Gedungsen
stops.detail: With a 15-meter high tidal wave, the Indalsälven created a new course through the porous gravel moraine and left the Gedungsen quiet and waterless.

stops.name: Freilichtbühne
stops.detail: Near the Dead Fall there is an open-air stage where folk comedies are performed every year in summer.

stops.name: Bispgården
stops.detail: The site is located between the towns of Hammarstrand and Bispgården in the municipality of Ragunda in Jämtland.

stops.name: Hammarstrand
stops.detail: Today, the town of Hammarstrand is located where the center of the lake used to be.

stops.name: Hammerforsen
stops.detail: A smaller waterfall, Hammerforsen, also emerged near the town, the energy of which was later used for a hydroelectric power station.
